snippet.title: Kung Fu (NES) Gameplay 480p | No Commentary - Nintendo, Oct 1985 (Orig Hardware Composite)
snippet.description:
Kung Fu is an action game released for Nintendo's classic 8-bit NES console on October 18 1985. All audio/visual elements copyright 1985, Nintendo. Music composed by ?

https://nesguide.com/games/kung-fu/

This video was produced for NESguide.com - a website that attempts to organize the NES catalog and make it easy to explore. Gameplays from this channel are featured throughout the NESguide website to showcase the original basic mechanics and audio/visual design of each title. Thank you for your continued support of this project, since 2007!


ABOUT KUNG FU (NES)

The player takes the role of Keiji Thomas, a man in a martial arts uniform and slippers. Thomas's girlfriend, Sylvia, has been kidnapped by "Mr. X", and Tom must fight through five side-scrolling levels full of enemies to rescue her. The first level contains standard Kung Fu henchmen and knife throwers. But subsequent levels introduces dwarves, killer bees, fire-breathing dragons, and snakes.

AKA: Kung-Fu Master, Spartan X
